# PR #3346 fresh pre-merge integration review

Base: `88af9f937908b46e8c5f9f7fddd9e8748c917d46`  
Head: `b1108874cab28d23f660aa22c11c863466a84a8e`  
Review: read-only; no source, index, HEAD, branch or GitHub changes. No delegated reviewers.

## Strengths

- The application service-drain move preserves the complete function AST, including cancellation propagation, primary-error preservation, TTS cleanup in `finally`, scheduler shutdown, worker settlement and SSH session-before-master ordering. `app_lifecycle.py` awaits the new application-layer owner at the same lifecycle seam.
- The warm-up completion callback remains app-owned and resolves the current Console attachment on the UI loop. Shutdown/unattached checks are preserved; it does not retain an obsolete view or introduce a boot freeze. Provider readiness, keybinding help, avatar resolution and citation footer delegates resolve their existing defining-module dependencies at use time.
- Lazy SSH registry imports retain the existing explicit type exports and run-end tombstone behavior. The changed optional-service reads retain their `AttributeError` fallback while allowing unrelated failures to propagate.
- The top-level Packaging history gate rebalances 26 forbidden locator observations as `2 * 44 + 24 * 38 = 1,000`, with every large row count still exactly 100 times its baseline. Both new mix-in message anchors are in the canonical locator union, generated query plans and distribution. The unchanged qualification-manifest validator requires every canonical locator in both history sizes, SEARCH-only plans, zero scans, matching pragmas and the same latency/trial thresholds.
- Gate changes retain constraints: no existing module-size ceiling increases or disappears; 23 decrease. All 12 new pinned owners have exact measured ceilings. UI-ready/preimport/warm-up numeric budgets remain unchanged. The UI census preserves all 1,328 previous entries in order and appends five selectors, reaching its raised floor of 1,333.
- Test repairs preserve meaningful failure behavior. The optional warm-up exception accepts only absence of the declared `textual_serve` root and tests that required/transitive failures still raise; fixture transport cleanup releases only its owned barriers before real disposal; the completed-settings-task drain yields without suppressing task errors; the refreeze test waits for both original outcomes within the original deadline.
- Evidence qualification distinguishes historical captures, current source, reproduced defects and unconfirmed hosted triggers. The verifier passed against the exact head: 1,620 current evidence/source records plus historical source hash groups of 79, 77 and 77, each explicitly limited to its captured commit. The retained-log fixture redaction is disclosed with source and original/redacted hashes rather than silently represented as original bytes.

## Issues

### Critical

None found in the reviewed scope.

### Important

1. **Independent unchanged Library/screen size guards fail or worsen on the original review head.** The general module-size dictionary comparison did not cover these separate guards, and required CI did not enroll the relevant original cases. Read-only measurement against the exact original guard logic found:

   | Changed owner | Base | Head | Existing limit |
   | --- | --- | --- | --- |
   | `UI/Library_Modules/library_prompts_controller.py:5356` | 5,100 lines | 5,356 lines | 5,100 lines |
   | `UI/Library_Modules/library_prompt_browse_controller.py:286` | 281 lines | 286 lines | 281 lines |
   | `UI/Screens/library_screen.py:38266` | 38,242 lines / 1,374 methods | 38,266 / 1,379 | 38,242 / 1,374 |
   | `UI/Screens/chat_screen.py:24675` | 24,652 lines / 744 methods | 24,675 / 745 | 24,605 / 741 |

   Paths above are relative to `tldw_chatbook/`. The Chat screen violation predates this PR, but this PR adds another 23 lines and one method; the other three owners passed at base and newly fail at head. Limits are in `Tests/Architecture/test_library_modules_size_ratchet.py:722` and `Tests/Architecture/test_screen_size_ratchet.py`. Preserve all pins and extract coherent existing-owner responsibilities; root is coordinating the correction and enrollment of the unchanged original guards. These later-confirmed findings supersede the initial no-finding verdict for the fixed head.

### Minor

None found in the reviewed scope. No subjective style findings are reported.

## Recommendations

Resolve the Library controller and screen overruns without raising any ceilings and enroll the relevant unchanged original guards. Combine the focused correction review with the separately assigned core and UI reviews before merging.

## Assessment

**Ready to merge? With fixes, for the original fixed review head.**

The non-feature application/tool extractions preserve existing execution, error and retirement contracts. Their changes did not weaken existing numeric constraints, but separate Library controller and screen guards expose PR-introduced or worsened overruns that must be fixed. This is not an independent endorsement of other source files assigned to the core/UI reviewers.

## Coverage and verification limits

Read all changed production hunks in this assigned scope, including every new/moved body:

- `tldw_chatbook/app.py`, `app_command_providers.py`, `app_config_notifications.py`, `app_idle_warmup.py`, `app_lifecycle.py`, `app_service_wiring.py`, `app_shutdown.py`.
- `tldw_chatbook/Utils/app_shutdown.py` and `Notes/notes_sync_startup.py`.
- `tldw_chatbook/Agents/agent_service.py`, `plain_chat_tool_surface.py`.
- `tldw_chatbook/Tools/character_tool_service.py`, `remote_session_registry.py`, `web_tool_impls.py`.
- `tldw_chatbook/Event_Handlers/Chat_Events/chat_rag_events.py`.
- `tldw_chatbook/css/build_css.py`; four changed `scripts/` gate/census files.
- `Packaging/speculative_voice_history_gate.py`, including its full locator collection, synthetic history seeding, plan capture, paired measurements and pass predicate. Adjacent unchanged child contracts checked: `Packaging/qualify_speculative_voice.py`, `Packaging/generate_voice_qualification_manifest.py::validate_completed_pair_history_gate`, the manifest mutation tests, native voice-promotion locator checks, and both new mix-in anchor index declarations/no-statistics cleanup-plan test. There are no changed `.github` workflow files in the fixed range.

Coverage correction: the independent Library controller size guard was unchanged in this PR and was missed by the initial changed-gate review; the general module-size check alone does not qualify all size constraints. The later Important finding above now records it. The initial inventory searched the nonexistent `tldw_chatbook/Packaging` path and incorrectly stated there were no Packaging changes. A full fixed-range file inventory found the top-level Packaging file above; it is now reviewed. No other production file in the assigned remaining-directory scope was omitted by that audit.

Also inspected the adjacent defining-owner seams in provider readiness, first-send warming and Workbench help; all changed architecture/performance gate and census diffs; test/fixture removals and replacements across the diff; new regression controls for extraction identities, service access, readiness, cleanup and guard behavior. New core and UI feature-test additions were sampled for false-green patterns and deferred in-depth semantic review to their assigned reviewers, rather than rereviewing those feature owners.

Requirements/context read: supplied AGENTS guidance; the approved mix-in spec, ADR-286, implementation plan and task 38544; app-shell architecture and adjacent Console/agent/tool/Notes ownership code; testing/live-verification lessons; verification/provenance material and current redaction proof. Preserved QA artifacts were not all reread individually.

Fresh read-only checks: exact shutdown AST identity; Notes helper body equivalence (one annotation spelling changes under postponed annotations); existing/new size-budget comparison and exact new-pin measurement; census-prefix identity; committed evidence/source verifier. Checkout was clean at initial review completion at the exact review head; subsequent coordinator-owned fixes currently in the working tree are outside this original fixed-head verdict until separately reviewed.

Qualification limit: the completed-pair full-history performance test retains its pre-existing strict xfail for eight unindexed legacy locators; a green suite is not proof that the entire child history gate passes. The source continues to refuse scans and the two added mix-in anchors have leading indexes and independent real no-statistics plan coverage. No new waiver/threshold change was introduced.

Skipped: no pytest, mounted app, performance rerun, full suite, real-provider/cache experiment, GitHub mutation or independent retrieval of hosted job results. Current hosted successes were supplied by the coordinator. Remaining runtime risk is bounded by the separate current-head CI/native evidence and complementary reviews; this pass does not establish new live performance or cache savings.
